facts: Unfortunately, your claim for Day Care Treatment is not covered as per your policy.
For further details, contact our claims team.

cited_clauses.quote: Day Care Treatment means medical treatment, and/ or Surgical Procedure which is: a. undertaken under general or local anesthesia in a Hospital/ Day Care Centre in less than 24 consecutive hours because of technological advancement, and b. which would have otherwise required a Hospitalization of more than 24 hours.
Treatment normally taken on an out-patient basis is not included in the scope of this definition.

reasoning: The policy defines Day Care Treatment as a procedure that requires less than 24 consecutive hours and would otherwise need a hospital stay of more than 24 hours. The claim for Day Care Treatment does not meet these criteria.
relief_sought: We request that the claim be reconsidered and covered as per the policy.
document_checklist: Copy of the claim rejection letter
Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
deadline_note: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.
